workflows.name: pkgdown-all.yaml
workflows.description: Triggers the core pkgdown deployment and cleanup workflows.

workflows.name: test-coverage.yaml
workflows.description: Compute test coverage and publish coverage-summary.json artifact

workflows.name: workflow-template-check.yaml
workflows.description: Check if GitHub Actions workflows match gsm.utils templates

workflows.name: qcthat.yaml
workflows.description: Generate qcthat quality control reports for pull requests and releases and manage user acceptance testing.

workflows.name: testdata.yaml
workflows.description: On merges to dev/main, ask gsm.datasim to rebuild the shared gsm test data bundle.

workflows.name: testdata-pr.yaml
workflows.description: On PRs to dev/main in test data input packages, build one test data bundle from the PR's head commit.

workflows.name: testdata-pr-cleanup.yaml
workflows.description: When a PR closes, delete the test data bundles that testdata-pr.yaml built for it.
